outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: (1) carry_commit - the one reader the filing's carry, tree_work and recut_wrong share - seeds its scratch index from the tree's own index (_seed_from_index: ls-files -s -z piped into update-index -z --index-info, the tree's index read and never written) instead of read-tree HEAD, so a file staged with add -f over an ignore rule is carried. (2) An invariant, not an enumeration: before the commit is written, every path tree_changed lists (git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain -z -uall --no-renames), record paths aside, must read in the scratch index as the tree's file holds it (_unheld: diff --name-only for other bytes, ls-files -o for a file the index lacks, literal pathspecs in chunks of 100); otherwise carry_commit returns no commit and names the paths, so tree_work stops the redo before drop_tree. It is checked on bytes, not names: a name check refuses a staged-then-deleted file (status 'AD') that loses nothing - measured with git 2.53 in a scratch repo. (3) _links_added renamed _links_touched: any changed path with mode 160000 on either side is a link, so a moved submodule pointer refuses the recut; the refusal text names it. (4) redo_left(ctx, state, task_id, tree) asks redo_held: True when no work path is unmerged, each path the tree's HEAD did not move since the pinned work's base reads as refs/audit/redo/<id> holds it, and each moved path is changed there - then the stop says the tree already holds the work and prescribes removing the patch and the pin, not an apply; False names the lacking paths and prescribes git apply --3way in that tree; None says how to tell (git -C <tree> diff <pin> -- <path>). tests/test_drive_phase.py ar-block: ar15, ar16, ar17, ar17b, ar6d, ar6e added; _ab_red_at_base gains prepare(root) and _ar_at_decision passes then/prepare; helpers _force_added, _with_submodule, _move_submodule, _drop_carry, _kept_named. ar-block 25/25 (was 19/19). outcome.descriptive: A redo now carries force-added files, refuses before the old tree comes down when its work commit would not hold every path git status lists, refuses a moved submodule pointer, and its stop prescribes an apply only where the tree lacks the work.

testsAdded: ar15: a file force-added over an ignore rule is carried by the redo into the recut tree, named on the did-line, and held by the carry ref moved there
ar16: a redo over a tree whose work moves a submodule pointer is refused before anything comes down; the submodule commit is still the tree's
ar17: a read of the work that misses a path git status lists (the seed read emptied, the filed carry ref taken away) refuses the redo before anything comes down
ar17b: a read holding a path with bytes other than the tree's file (add -A emptied) refuses the redo before anything comes down
ar6d: a redo stopped before its old tree came down - the stop says the tree already holds the work and prescribes no apply
ar6e: the other direction - a tree lacking the work is told to apply the patch three-way
